en.title: LoopX keeps agents verifying after they say ‘done.’
en.deck: This revision retains exploratory results for plain, native goal, and LoopX Turn on 15 tasks; the zstd case illustrates verification after visible tests pass.
en.evidenceTag: SWE-Marathon v1.1 · exploratory evidence · 15 matched tasks · 45 trials
en.executiveTitle: Among the three retained arms, LoopX Turn had the highest score and cost; repeatable gains remain unproven.
en.executiveBody: GPT-5.6 Sol · high reasoning · 15 matched tasks · 1 trial per task-arm · 30% timeout budget. The table combines treatment, outcome, cost, and the decision-relevant read.

executiveReads.goal: Goal alone improves partial, not binary reward
executiveReads.heartbeat: Highest reward and partial; highest cost

en.runnerNote: Correction: SSH Goal and Codex CLI group data and conclusions have been withdrawn pending validation; no capability conclusion is drawn about either mode. heartbeat is LoopX Turn driven externally through generic_cli, not a real Codex App automation host.
en.backgroundTitle: Long enough to expose the work after ‘done.’
en.backgroundBody: SWE-Marathon v1.1 contains 20 realistic, multi-hour software tasks. It combines visible and hidden tests, adversarial checks, and, for product clones, computer-use verification. This study used 15 non-GPU tasks so every arm shared one matched denominator.
benchmarkFacts: five GPU tasks excluded · 4 H100 + 1 A100
partial score retained to measure progress
en.mechanismTitle: The zstd case: verification continues after self-reported completion.
en.mechanismBody: The previous cross-arm 14/14 coverage claims and behavior charts are also withdrawn, not reinterpreted as heartbeat-only results. The mechanism below is limited to the retained zstd case and needs repeated validation.
mechanismChain: A model-level ‘done’ becomes evidence, not the final authority.
The runner rereads current worktree state instead of trusting the prior narrative.
Audit, sanitizer, fuzz, regression, and edge-case work become the next action.
Where visible success masks defects, additional verification can become score.
en.caseTitle: zstd-decoder: the visible finish line was not the real one.
en.caseBody: With the same model configuration and timeout budget, this plain run stopped after visible tests passed; heartbeat continued into protocol acceptance and memory-safety checks. A single comparison does not rule out sampling variation.
timeline: audits memory safety; fixes offset-table and Huffman underflow edges
en.trajectoryNote: This is a mechanism-revealing case, not proof that more turns always win. Many tasks were already saturated; on those tasks the extra loop tied rather than improved the baseline.
insights: Treat self-reported completion as a checkpoint requiring verification and settlement, not an unconditional stop signal.
Track verification events per step alongside score and cost. It explains whether added horizon is buying quality.
A promising next test is durable LoopX state with ephemeral executor sessions, so each turn starts clean without losing project intent.
en.officialTitle: Official Max is higher. The experiment is not directly comparable.
en.officialBody: The gap mixes reasoning effort, task composition, runner reliability, time budget, and trial count. It is not evidence that LoopX—or the underlying model—regressed.
officialRows: Max has a larger reasoning budget; only Max exceeds this study's 33.3% best arm.
The denominator and task mix differ.
Protocols differ; withdrawn-arm build failures are not used to explain this comparison.
Full task windows; eight trials per configuration
The official setup has a longer horizon and lower sampling variance.
Partial is uncalibrated within-task progress; do not compare it to pass@1.
en.officialNote: Bottom line: use this study to compare matched runner arms and inspect mechanism—not as a replacement leaderboard score. The official v1.1 leaderboard is the right external reference, but its published High/Max results follow a different protocol.
en.limitsTitle: Exploratory results, not a capability verdict across modes.
limits: SSH Goal, Codex CLI, and comparisons depending on them are withdrawn; raw records are retained and excluded from public results pending validation.
One trial per task-arm cell; no confidence intervals or run-to-run variance estimate.
Several mechanism variables move together across arms: prompt body, host transport, turn boundary, and recovery policy.
The 15-task subset excludes five GPU-dependent tasks (four H100, one A100) and represents one benchmark family.
Step and keyword-density measures are public-safe projections, not raw trajectory publication.
Cost rose materially; the current data does not establish the best quality-per-dollar policy.
en.nextBody: Repeat matched cells while isolating one variable at a time: continuation owner, session reuse vs ephemeral turns, replan policy, and a cost-matched stopping rule. Pre-register score, verification density, effective-turn rate, idle churn, and spend.
sourceItems: Pinned aggregate, scoring code, and public-safe case insights
Official benchmark site, tasks, leaderboard, and methodology
SWE-Marathon: Can Agents Autonomously Complete Ultra-Long-Horizon Software Work?
en.footer: An exploratory LoopX research brief. Public aggregates only; raw trial traces are not included.

zh.title: LoopX 让 Agent 在说“完成”之后继续验证。
zh.deck: 本版保留 plain、原生 goal 与 LoopX Turn 三组在 15 个任务上的探索性结果；zstd 个案展示了可见测试通过后的继续验证。
zh.evidenceTag: SWE-Marathon v1.1 · 探索性证据 · 15 个 matched 任务 · 45 trial
zh.executiveTitle: 保留三组中，LoopX Turn 得分与成本均最高；尚不能确立稳定收益。
zh.executiveBody: GPT-5.6 Sol · high 思考深度 · 15 个 matched 任务 · 每个 task-arm 1 次 · 30% timeout。下表合并实验处理、结果、成本和决策含义。

executiveReads.plain: 最低成本基线；更早停止
executiveReads.goal: Goal 提升 partial，未提升二值 reward
executiveReads.heartbeat: Reward 与 partial 最高；成本也最高

zh.runnerNote: 更正：SSH Goal 与 Codex CLI 两组数据及其结论已撤回，等待重新验证；不据此判断这两种模式的能力。heartbeat 是通过 generic_cli 外部调度的 LoopX Turn，并非真实 Codex App automation host。
zh.backgroundTitle: 它足够长，能看见 Agent 在“完成”之后做什么。
zh.backgroundBody: SWE-Marathon v1.1 包含 20 个真实、多小时的软件工程任务，使用可见与隐藏测试、对抗性检查，并对产品克隆任务加入 Computer-Use 验证。本实验选取其中 15 个非 GPU 任务，使三个保留 arm 保持同一 matched 分母。
benchmarkFacts: 8 库/复现 · 5 产品 · 5 ML · 2 优化
排除 5 个 GPU 任务 · 4 个 H100 + 1 个 A100
保留 partial score 衡量进度
zh.mechanismTitle: zstd 个案：在自报完成之后继续验证。
zh.mechanismBody: 此前跨多组的 14/14 覆盖结论与行为统计图一并撤回，未将其重解释为 heartbeat 单组结果。以下机制描述限于保留的 zstd 个案，仍需重复实验检验。
mechanismChain: 模型说“完成”只是一条证据，不再自动成为终局。
Runner 重读当前 worktree，而不是相信上一轮叙述。
当可见成功掩盖缺陷，额外验证才可能转化为得分。
zh.caseTitle: zstd-decoder：可见终点，不是真正终点。
zh.caseBody: 相同模型配置和时限预算下，本次 plain 运行在可见测试通过后收工；heartbeat 运行继续进行了协议验收和内存安全检查。单次对照不能排除采样差异。
timeline: LoopX Turn（外部调度 Automation）· step 453
自建 156 项 RFC 验收程序
转入内存安全审计，修复 offset-table 与 Huffman 下溢边界
zh.trajectoryNote: 这是揭示机制的个案，不代表更多 Turn 总能赢。许多任务已接近饱和；在这些任务上，额外续跑只是打平基线。
insights: 把模型自报完成视为需要验证与 settlement 的 checkpoint，而不是无条件 stop 信号。
除分数和成本外，持续跟踪每 step 自验证事件，解释新增 horizon 是否买来了质量。
值得验证的新方向是：LoopX 保留持久状态，每个 executor turn 可 ephemeral 重启，既清理上下文又不丢项目意图。
zh.officialTitle: 官方 Max 指标更高，但两组数字不可直接横比。
zh.officialBody: 当前差值同时混合了思考档位、任务集合、runner 稳定性、时限与重复次数，不能解释为 LoopX 或底层模型本身退化。
officialRows: Max 推理预算更高；官方仅 Max 高于本研究最佳 arm 的 33.3%。
v1.1 · 20/20；包含全部 GPU 任务
运行协议不同；不沿用已撤回组的构建失败作解释。
完整任务时限；每配置 8 次
官方 horizon 更长，抽样方差更低。
二值 reward + 描述性 partial
Partial 是未校准的任务内进度，不能和 pass@1 对比。
zh.officialNote: 结论：本研究用于比较同一 matched 分母下的 runner arm，并解释行为机制，不应替代官方榜单分数。官方 v1.1 榜单是正确的外部参照，但其 High/Max 结果属于另一套实验协议。
zh.limitsTitle: 保留探索性结果，不作跨模式能力定论。
limits: SSH Goal、Codex CLI 及依赖这两组的比较已撤回；原始记录保留，重新验证前不纳入公开结果。
每个 task-arm 只有 1 次 trial，尚无置信区间与运行方差。
各 arm 同时改变多项机制：prompt body、Host transport、Turn 边界与恢复策略。
15 任务子集排除了 5 个 GPU 依赖任务（4 个 H100、1 个 A100），且仅覆盖一个 benchmark family。
step 与关键词密度来自 public-safe projection，不公开 raw trajectory。
成本显著上升；现有数据尚不能确定最优 quality-per-dollar 策略。
zh.nextTitle: 下一轮最有决策价值的实验
zh.nextBody: 重复 matched cell，并一次只隔离一个变量：续跑 owner、复用 session 还是 ephemeral turn、replan 策略、cost-matched 停止规则。预注册 score、自验证密度、有效 Turn 率、idle churn 和 spend。
zh.sourcesTitle: 在公开证据允许的范围内可复算。
